title: Livestock Safety Plan
description: Free Livestock Safety Plan template for agriculture you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hazards and controls, facilities and practices, approval & sign-off.
html:

Hazards And Controls

HazardControl measure
Kicks, bites, crush and tramplingLow-stress handling, proper yards and crushes, escape routes, training
Zoonotic diseases (e.g. brucellosis, Q fever, leptospirosis)Hygiene, gloves, vaccination, protect open wounds, report symptoms
Birthing and veterinary workRestraint, PPE, sharps handling, vet instructions
Manure gases and confined pitsVentilation, no entry without permit and gas testing
Working alone with animalsCheck-in system, mobile communication
Animal transport and loadingRamps, non-slip floors, trained handlers

Facilities And Practices

☐ Handling yards, crushes and gates in good repair

☐ Non-slip flooring and good lighting

☐ Clear exit routes from pens and yards

☐ Bulls and aggressive animals segregated and signed

☐ Visitors and children kept away from animal areas

☐ First aid kit and emergency numbers available
